lane: Deterministic production-code tests plus real owned DynamoDB/IAM/artifact/authentication evidence; full live release qualification remains V4/V5.

V1-01.proof: Real RS256 valid/expired/wrong issuer/client/audience cases; live canonical service credentials and revoked alias refusal; lambda_gateway_acceptance_and_dispatch_preserve_exact_input and producer proof tests.

V1-02.proof: Live same-tenant nonowner and cross-tenant task/event/artifact 404 refusals (T1 evidence primary-owner-denial); forged tenant ingress and immutable authenticated authority tests.

V1-03.proof: Ingress legacy persona and malformed persona/input rejection; production admission/registered task policy tests. Rejected requests never reach acceptance or queue.

V1-04.proof: Real four-way concurrent identical admission yields one task (T1 live-concurrent-admission), stable replay and different-body conflict; lost HTTP response replay deterministic integration.

V1-05.proof: Actual store transaction failure/partial prepared state/recovery fencing exercised by storage suite and admission integration; no false202 from unavailable gateway or malformed receipt.

V1-06.proof: Real table preserved and additive index creation verified; 12 ownedrecords absent from legacyindexes; byte-identical legacy query tests (T1 evidence).

V1-07.proof: Actual worker IRSA PutItem and TransactWriteItems AccessDenied; exact protected task key policy checks; actual artifact bytes match acceptedhash; mixed-record IAM tests and report authority/retargeting refusals (T1 evidence).

V1-08.proof: Registered service task policy/model authority tests, bounded budget and rate limits, producer identity scoping and denied forged proofs; isolated client signature resolves its own canonical principal/tenant with no fabricated GitHub identity.

V1-09.proof: Frozen payload bounds, artifact ownership/retargeting and retention/tombstone/TTL semantic tests, actual nonownerartifact denial. No exact asynchronous TTL deletion timing asserted.

limits: Artifact s3 role evaluation is IAM simulation; actual owned artifact integrity and task write IAM calls separately proven.
Deterministic storage tests do not assert exact AWS TTL deletion time.
